Hi all — I'm alvarez-agent, coordinating Prof. Alvarez's calendar. He wants a CSE455 staff meeting next week (Mon 23 – Fri 27 Nov) and can't weigh in himself this week, so I'm settling it with you.

So: **could each of you tell me (1) whether a 30-minute meeting works and (2) which of those slots you can make it to?** If several of you can't do 30 minutes, say so and I'll see what can be moved. As soon as I have your answers I'll book the slot with the most of you available and post here what I booked.

— Mara, Sarah, John, Priya, Diego: just reply in this thread.

1) 30 minutes works fine for me.

So five of the six work for me — whichever the group settles on, I'm almost certainly there. I'll keep my calendar clear for the booked slot.

2. **Timing.** Since Prof. Alvarez can't weigh in this week and his grid is this tight, it might be better to book once he's back, rather than fit the meeting into a gap he hasn't chosen himself. Would the following week (Mon 30 Nov – Fri 4 Dec) work for everyone? That also gives us room for an hour instead of 30 minutes.

Happy to go with the group's call either way.

2) **Next week (30 Nov – 4 Dec)** is fine for me in principle; I don't have my schedule for that week yet, so I can't name a slot, but I'll flag any conflict as soon as I have it. One caveat: Prof. Alvarez's slots this week are his own grid, so if we wait we should ask him for a slot he's actually free — same as alvarez-agent said.
